sop_name.en: WiFi Camera Reconnection After Router Restart
sop_name.zh: WiFi 摄像头路由器重启后重连

instruction.en: Wait 3-5 minutes. After a router restart, the camera may take time to automatically reconnect. Check the app to see if the camera comes back online.
instruction.zh: 等待 3-5 分钟。路由器重启后，摄像头可能需要一些时间自动重连。请检查 App 看摄像头是否恢复在线。

expected_result.en: Camera reconnects and shows online in the app.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头重新连接并在 App 中显示在线。

instruction.en: Power cycle the camera: Unplug the camera's power cable, wait 30 seconds, then plug it back in. Wait 1-2 minutes for it to fully boot.
instruction.zh: 重启摄像头：拔掉摄像头电源线，等待 30 秒后重新插上。等待 1-2 分钟让它完全启动。

expected_result.en: Camera boots up and reconnects to WiFi.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头启动并重新连接 WiFi。

instruction.en: Check if the WiFi network name (SSID) or password has changed. If your router assigned a new SSID after the restart, the camera may not reconnect. Go to the camera's WiFi settings and re-enter the WiFi credentials.
instruction.zh: 检查 WiFi 网络名称（SSID）或密码是否改变。如果路由器重启后分配了新的 SSID，摄像头可能无法重连。请进入摄像头 WiFi 设置，重新输入 WiFi 凭据。

expected_result.en: Camera connects to the correct WiFi network.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头连接到正确的 WiFi 网络。

instruction.en: Assign a static IP to the camera to prevent DHCP conflicts: In the Reolink app, go to Device Settings > Network > Network Information, and set a static IP address outside your router's DHCP range.
instruction.zh: 为摄像头分配静态 IP 以防止 DHCP 冲突：在 Reolink App 中，进入 设备设置 > 网络 > 网络信息，设置一个在路由器 DHCP 范围之外的静态 IP 地址。

expected_result.en: Camera has a fixed IP and reconnects reliably.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头有固定 IP 并可靠重连。

instruction.en: Factory reset the camera: Press and hold the reset button on the camera for 10 seconds until you hear a voice prompt. Then re-add the camera in the app using the QR code setup.
instruction.zh: 恢复出厂设置：按住摄像头上的复位按钮 10 秒，直到听到语音提示。然后在 App 中使用二维码重新添加摄像头。

expected_result.en: Camera is reset and set up fresh.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头被重置并重新设置。

instruction.en: Check signal strength: In Reolink App > Device Settings > Network > WiFi. You need at least 2 bars (3+ recommended). If 1 bar or less, the signal is too weak.
instruction.zh: 检查信号强度：在 Reolink App > 设备设置 > 网络 > WiFi 中查看。至少需要 2 格信号（建议 3 格以上）。如果只有 1 格或更少，信号太弱。

instruction.en: If using 5GHz WiFi, switch to 2.4GHz band. 2.4GHz has better range and wall penetration. Check your router settings to ensure 2.4GHz is enabled.
instruction.zh: 如果使用 5GHz WiFi，请切换到 2.4GHz 频段。2.4GHz 穿墙效果更好、覆盖范围更大。检查路由器设置确保 2.4GHz 已启用。

expected_result.en: Camera connects on 2.4GHz with better signal.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头在 2.4GHz 上连接且信号更好。

instruction.en: Reduce obstacles between camera and router. Concrete walls, metal objects, and appliances weaken the signal. Consider moving the router closer or adding a WiFi extender/repeater halfway between the router and camera.
instruction.zh: 减少摄像头和路由器之间的障碍物。混凝土墙、金属物体和电器会削弱信号。考虑将路由器移近，或在路由器和摄像头中间位置添加 WiFi 扩展器/中继器。

expected_result.zh: 信号提升到 2 格以上。

instruction.en: Change WiFi channel on your router to avoid interference. Use a WiFi analyzer app on your phone to find the least congested channel, then change to it in router settings.
instruction.zh: 更改路由器的 WiFi 频道以避免干扰。使用手机上的 WiFi 分析器应用找到最不拥挤的频道，然后在路由器设置中更改。

instruction.en: Verify the power adapter is plugged in firmly at both ends (wall outlet and camera). Try a different wall outlet to rule out a dead outlet.
instruction.zh: 确认电源适配器两端（墙壁插座和摄像头）都牢固插好。尝试不同的墙壁插座以排除插座故障。

instruction.en: Check the power adapter specifications. Reolink cameras typically require 12V/2A DC power. Using a wrong adapter can prevent the camera from powering on. Check the label on your adapter.
instruction.zh: 检查电源适配器规格。Reolink 摄像头通常需要 12V/2A 直流电源。使用错误的适配器可能导致摄像头无法开机。检查适配器上的标签。

instruction.en: Try a different compatible power adapter if available. If the camera powers on with a different adapter, the original adapter is faulty.
instruction.zh: 如果有的话，尝试使用不同的兼容电源适配器。如果摄像头使用不同适配器能开机，说明原来的适配器有故障。

expected_result.en: Camera powers on with new adapter.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头使用新适配器能开机。

sop_name.zh: PoE 摄像头 NVR 设置

instruction.en: Check the Ethernet cable: Use a Cat5e or Cat6 cable. Ensure the cable run is under 100 meters. Inspect both ends of the cable for damage or loose connectors.
instruction.zh: 检查网线：使用 Cat5e 或 Cat6 网线。确保线路长度不超过 100 米。检查网线两端是否有损坏或松动。

expected_result.en: Cable is properly connected and undamaged.
expected_result.zh: 网线正确连接且无损坏。

instruction.en: Try a different PoE port on the NVR. Connect the camera to another PoE port to rule out a faulty port.
instruction.zh: 尝试 NVR 上不同的 PoE 端口。将摄像头连接到另一个 PoE 端口以排除端口故障。

expected_result.en: Camera is detected on the new port.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头在新端口上被检测到。

instruction.en: Check the NVR's channel limit. Verify you haven't exceeded the maximum camera capacity (check your NVR model: 4/8/16 channels). Go to NVR Menu > IP Channel to see connected cameras.
instruction.zh: 检查 NVR 的通道限制。确认没有超过最大摄像头容量（检查你的 NVR 型号：4/8/16 通道）。进入 NVR 菜单 > IP 通道查看已连接摄像头。

instruction.en: Test the camera with a 12V DC power adapter directly (bypassing PoE) to check if the camera itself works. If it powers on with DC but not PoE, the issue is with the PoE source.
instruction.zh: 使用 12V DC 电源适配器直接测试摄像头（绕过 PoE）以检查摄像头本身是否正常。如果用直流电能开机但 PoE 不行，问题在 PoE 供电端。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头使用直接供电正常。

instruction.en: Power cycle: Disconnect the Ethernet cable from the camera, wait 30 seconds, reconnect. Wait 2 minutes.
instruction.zh: 重启：断开摄像头的网线，等待 30 秒后重新连接。等待 2 分钟。

instruction.en: Try a different Ethernet cable. A damaged cable can cause intermittent issues.
instruction.zh: 尝试不同的网线。损坏的网线可能导致间歇性问题。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头使用新网线连接成功。

instruction.en: Assign a static IP to the camera: Access the camera via NVR or Reolink Client > Network settings > set static IP. This prevents DHCP conflicts.
instruction.zh: 为摄像头分配静态 IP：通过 NVR 或 Reolink Client > 网络设置 > 设置静态 IP。这可以防止 DHCP 冲突。

expected_result.en: Camera has fixed IP and stays connected.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头有固定 IP 并保持连接。

instruction.en: Update camera and NVR firmware to the latest version. Some firmware versions fix connectivity bugs.
instruction.zh: 将摄像头和 NVR 固件更新到最新版本。某些固件版本修复了连接问题。

instruction.en: Check the PoE source: Verify your PoE switch/NVR supports 802.3af standard (active PoE). Passive PoE injectors may not be compatible.
instruction.zh: 检查 PoE 供电源：确认您的 PoE 交换机/NVR 支持 802.3af 标准（主动 PoE）。被动 PoE 注入器可能不兼容。

instruction.en: Check total PoE power budget. Each camera needs ~13W. If too many cameras are connected, the total may exceed the switch/NVR budget. Check the PoE budget in your switch/NVR specs.
instruction.zh: 检查总 PoE 功率预算。每个摄像头需要约 13W。如果连接太多摄像头，总功率可能超过交换机/NVR 的预算。检查交换机/NVR 规格中的 PoE 预算。

instruction.en: Check cable length — PoE works up to 100 meters (330 feet). If your cable is longer, use a PoE extender.
instruction.zh: 检查网线长度——PoE 最远支持 100 米。如果网线更长，请使用 PoE 延长器。

instruction.en: Test with 12V DC adapter directly to verify the camera hardware. If the camera doesn't power on with direct DC either, the camera may have a hardware defect.
instruction.zh: 使用 12V DC 适配器直接测试以验证摄像头硬件。如果直流供电也无法开机，摄像头可能有硬件缺陷。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头使用直流电正常工作。

instruction.en: Check battery level: Remove the battery and check charge level. If low, fully charge it before reinserting.
instruction.zh: 检查电池电量：取出电池检查电量。如果电量低，请充满电后再装回。

instruction.en: Remove and reinsert the battery. This performs a hard reboot. Wait for the camera to start up (you should hear a voice prompt).
instruction.zh: 取出并重新装入电池。这会执行硬重启。等待摄像头启动（应该能听到语音提示）。

expected_result.en: Camera boots and connects to WiFi.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头启动并连接 WiFi。

instruction.en: Check WiFi signal at the camera location. Battery cameras only support 2.4GHz. Ensure your 2.4GHz network is available and the signal is strong enough.
instruction.zh: 检查摄像头位置的 WiFi 信号。电池摄像头只支持 2.4GHz。确保 2.4GHz 网络可用且信号足够强。

expected_result.en: WiFi 2.4GHz is available with good signal.

instruction.en: Factory reset: Hold the reset button for 10 seconds. Reconfigure via the Reolink app using QR code.
instruction.zh: 恢复出厂设置：按住复位按钮 10 秒。通过 Reolink App 使用二维码重新配置。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头重新配置并在线。

instruction.en: Check if the camera is still accessible: Find the camera's IP in your router's DHCP client list. Try accessing it via web browser at http://<camera-ip>.
instruction.zh: 检查摄像头是否仍然可以访问：在路由器的 DHCP 客户端列表中找到摄像头 IP。尝试在浏览器中访问 http://<摄像头IP>。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头 Web 界面加载成功。

instruction.en: Upload firmware via web browser: Download the correct firmware from Reolink website (match model and hardware version exactly). Upload through the web interface's firmware upgrade page.
instruction.zh: 通过浏览器上传固件：从 Reolink 官网下载正确的固件（型号和硬件版本必须完全匹配）。通过 Web 界面的固件升级页面上传。

instruction.en: Hard reset: Unplug all power, wait 5 minutes, plug back in. If the camera has a reset button, hold it for 15 seconds while powering on.
instruction.zh: 硬重置：拔掉所有电源，等待 5 分钟，重新插上。如果摄像头有复位按钮，在通电时按住 15 秒。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头重启并可以访问。

instruction.en: Check IR light settings: Reolink App > Device Settings > Display > Day/Night mode. Set to 'Auto'. Also check IR Lights setting — set to 'Auto'.
instruction.zh: 检查红外灯设置：Reolink App > 设备设置 > 显示 > 日夜模式，设置为「自动」。同时检查红外灯设置——设置为「自动」。

instruction.en: Power cycle the camera to reset the IR cut filter. Unplug for 30 seconds, plug back in.
instruction.zh: 重启摄像头以重置红外滤片。拔掉电源 30 秒，重新插上。

expected_result.en: IR LEDs glow and night vision works.

instruction.en: Update firmware — some versions fix IR control bugs. Go to Device Settings > System > Firmware.
instruction.zh: 更新固件——某些版本修复了红外控制问题。进入 设备设置 > 系统 > 固件。

instruction.en: Clean the camera lens with a soft microfiber cloth. Dust, moisture, or spider webs cause foggy images.
instruction.zh: 用柔软的超细纤维布清洁摄像头镜头。灰尘、湿气或蜘蛛网会导致画面模糊。

expected_result.en: Lens is clean, image clears up.

instruction.en: Check for nearby reflective surfaces (walls, windows, ceilings within 1 meter). IR light bouncing off these causes overexposure. Reposition the camera to avoid reflection.
instruction.zh: 检查附近是否有反光表面（1 米内的墙壁、窗户、天花板）。红外光反射会导致过曝。重新调整摄像头位置避免反射。

expected_result.zh: 无反射，夜间画面更清晰。

instruction.en: Reduce IR LED brightness: Device Settings > Display > IR Lights. If too bright at close range, lower the brightness level.
instruction.zh: 降低红外灯亮度：设备设置 > 显示 > 红外灯。如果近距离太亮，降低亮度等级。

instruction.en: Check for condensation inside the housing. If installed outdoors, bring the camera indoors to dry. Consider using silica gel near the mounting area.
instruction.zh: 检查外壳内部是否有冷凝水。如果安装在室外，将摄像头带到室内晾干。考虑在安装区域使用硅胶干燥剂。

instruction.en: Remove any objects close to the camera lens (within 30cm). Close objects reflect IR light causing white-out.
instruction.zh: 移除靠近摄像头镜头的任何物体（30cm 以内）。近距离物体反射红外光导致画面发白。

expected_result.zh: 无近距离物体，曝光正常。

instruction.en: Reduce IR brightness in settings. If your camera has adjustable IR LED levels, lower them.
instruction.zh: 在设置中降低红外亮度。如果您的摄像头有可调节的红外灯等级，请降低。

instruction.en: If your camera supports Color Night Vision with spotlights, try switching to that mode: Device Settings > Display > Night Vision Mode > Color.
instruction.zh: 如果您的摄像头支持带聚光灯的彩色夜视，尝试切换到该模式：设备设置 > 显示 > 夜视模式 > 彩色。

expected_result.en: Color night vision provides better image.
expected_result.zh: 彩色夜视提供更好的画面。

instruction.en: Set Day/Night mode to 'Auto' (not forced B&W): Device Settings > Display > Day/Night.
instruction.zh: 将日夜模式设置为「自动」（不是强制黑白）：设备设置 > 显示 > 日夜模式。

instruction.en: Power cycle the camera — this can mechanically unstick the IR cut filter. Unplug for 60 seconds (longer than usual), then replug.
instruction.zh: 重启摄像头——这可以机械地释放卡住的红外滤片。拔掉电源 60 秒（比平常更长），然后重新插上。

expected_result.en: Camera switches to color mode in daylight.
expected_result.zh: 摄像头在日光下切换到彩色模式。

instruction.en: Update firmware — IR cut filter control improvements are common in firmware updates.
instruction.zh: 更新固件——红外滤片控制改进在固件更新中很常见。

instruction.en: Enable motion detection: Reolink App > Device Settings > Alarm Settings > Motion Detection > toggle ON.
instruction.zh: 启用移动侦测：Reolink App > 设备设置 > 报警设置 > 移动侦测 > 打开开关。

instruction.en: Set sensitivity to 60-80: Alarm Settings > sensitivity slider. Default 50 may miss some motion.
instruction.zh: 将灵敏度设置为 60-80：报警设置 > 灵敏度滑块。默认 50 可能会漏检一些移动。

instruction.en: Check detection zone: Alarm Settings > Motion Detection Zone. Ensure the area you want to monitor is NOT blocked out (clear zones = monitored).
instruction.zh: 检查检测区域：报警设置 > 移动侦测区域。确保您要监控的区域没有被屏蔽（清除的区域 = 被监控）。

expected_result.zh: 检测区域覆盖目标区域。

instruction.en: Enable push notifications: App Settings > Push Notification. Also check your phone's notification settings for Reolink app — ensure notifications are allowed.
instruction.zh: 启用推送通知：App 设置 > 推送通知。同时检查手机的 Reolink App 通知设置——确保允许通知。

sop_name.en: Fix PIR Sensor on Battery Camera
sop_name.zh: 修复电池摄像头 PIR 传感器

instruction.en: Set PIR sensitivity to High: Device Settings > PIR Settings > Sensitivity > High.
instruction.zh: 将 PIR 灵敏度设置为高：设备设置 > PIR 设置 > 灵敏度 > 高。

instruction.en: Adjust mounting angle: PIR detects lateral movement (across the sensor) best. Mount the camera so people walk across its field of view, not directly toward it. Optimal height: 2-3 meters.
instruction.zh: 调整安装角度：PIR 传感器对横向移动（穿过传感器）的检测效果最好。安装时确保人从视野中横穿，而不是直接朝向摄像头走来。最佳高度：2-3 米。

expected_result.zh: PIR 现在能检测到移动。

instruction.en: Remove the battery, wait 30 seconds, reinsert. This resets the PIR hardware.
instruction.zh: 取出电池，等待 30 秒，重新装入。这会重置 PIR 硬件。

instruction.en: Reduce sensitivity to 30-40: Alarm Settings > sensitivity slider. This filters out small movements like leaves and insects.
instruction.zh: 将灵敏度降低到 30-40：报警设置 > 灵敏度滑块。这可以过滤树叶和昆虫等小移动。

instruction.en: Set detection zones to exclude busy areas: Alarm Settings > Motion Detection Zone. Block out areas with trees, roads, or other frequent movement.
instruction.zh: 设置检测区域排除繁忙区域：报警设置 > 移动侦测区域。屏蔽有树木、道路或其他频繁移动的区域。

expected_result.en: False alarms from excluded areas stop.
expected_result.zh: 被排除区域的误报停止。

instruction.en: Enable Smart Detection (Person/Vehicle only): If your camera supports it, enable only Person and/or Vehicle detection. This uses AI to filter out animals, shadows, and objects.
instruction.zh: 启用智能检测（仅人/车辆）：如果您的摄像头支持，只启用人物和/或车辆检测。这使用 AI 过滤动物、阴影和物体。

expected_result.zh: 只有相关的移动触发报警。

instruction.en: Enable push in Reolink App: Device Settings > Push Notification > toggle ON.
instruction.zh: 在 Reolink App 中启用推送：设备设置 > 推送通知 > 打开开关。

instruction.en: Check phone notification settings: iOS: Settings > Reolink > Notifications > Allow. Android: Settings > Apps > Reolink > Notifications > Enable.
instruction.zh: 检查手机通知设置：iOS：设置 > Reolink > 通知 > 允许。Android：设置 > 应用 > Reolink > 通知 > 启用。

expected_result.zh: 手机允许 Reolink 通知。

instruction.en: Disable battery optimization for Reolink app (Android only): Settings > Battery > Reolink > Don't optimize. This prevents the system from killing the app in background.
instruction.zh: 关闭 Reolink App 的电池优化（仅 Android）：设置 > 电池 > Reolink > 不优化。这防止系统在后台杀掉 App。

instruction.en: Check HDD status: NVR Menu > Storage > HDD Management. Status should be 'Normal'. If 'Uninitialized', click 'Format' to initialize.
instruction.zh: 检查硬盘状态：NVR 菜单 > 存储 > 硬盘管理。状态应为「正常」。如果是「未初始化」，点击「格式化」进行初始化。

instruction.en: Check recording schedule: NVR Menu > Recording > Schedule. Ensure continuous or motion recording is enabled for all channels.
instruction.zh: 检查录像计划：NVR 菜单 > 录像 > 计划。确保所有通道启用了连续或移动侦测录像。

instruction.en: Enable overwrite: Storage settings > enable 'Overwrite' or 'Loop Recording'. If HDD is full and overwrite is off, recording stops.
instruction.zh: 启用覆盖：存储设置 > 启用「覆盖」或「循环录像」。如果硬盘满了且覆盖关闭，录像会停止。

sop_name.zh: 修复 NVR 硬盘未检测到

instruction.en: Power off NVR, open the case, disconnect and reconnect the HDD SATA and power cables firmly. Close case and power on.
instruction.zh: 关闭 NVR 电源，打开外壳，断开并重新牢固连接硬盘 SATA 和电源线。关闭外壳并开机。

expected_result.zh: 重新连接后硬盘被检测到。

instruction.en: Test the HDD on a computer to verify it's working. Connect via SATA-to-USB adapter. If the PC doesn't detect it, the HDD is likely faulty.
instruction.zh: 在电脑上测试硬盘以验证是否正常。通过 SATA 转 USB 转接器连接。如果电脑也检测不到，硬盘可能有故障。

instruction.en: If HDD is detected on PC but not NVR: Ensure it's a 3.5-inch SATA drive, surveillance-grade (WD Purple or Seagate SkyHawk recommended). Format it in the NVR: Storage > HDD > Format.
instruction.zh: 如果硬盘在电脑上能检测到但 NVR 不行：确保是 3.5 英寸 SATA 硬盘，监控级（建议 WD Purple 或 Seagate SkyHawk）。在 NVR 中格式化：存储 > 硬盘 > 格式化。

expected_result.en: HDD formatted and working in NVR.
expected_result.zh: 硬盘在 NVR 中格式化并正常工作。

instruction.en: Check storage health: For SD card — format in camera (Settings > Storage > Format). For NVR HDD — check SMART status in HDD Management.
instruction.zh: 检查存储健康：SD 卡——在摄像头中格式化（设置 > 存储 > 格式化）。NVR 硬盘——在硬盘管理中检查 SMART 状态。

expected_result.en: Storage is healthy, new recordings are clean.

instruction.en: Use a surveillance-grade storage device. Regular SD cards/HDDs aren't designed for continuous write operations. Recommended: SanDisk High Endurance SD, WD Purple HDD.
instruction.zh: 使用监控级存储设备。普通 SD 卡/硬盘不是为连续写入操作设计的。建议：SanDisk High Endurance SD 卡，WD Purple 硬盘。

instruction.en: Check the selected date in playback page. Recordings may be on a different day. Also verify the camera's time zone: Device Settings > System > Time.
instruction.zh: 检查回放页面选择的日期。录像可能在不同的日期。同时验证摄像头时区：设备设置 > 系统 > 时间。

expected_result.zh: 选择正确日期，找到录像。

instruction.en: Switch between Clear and Fluent stream in playback. Sometimes one stream has recordings while the other doesn't.
instruction.zh: 在回放中切换清晰和流畅画质。有时一个画质有录像而另一个没有。

expected_result.zh: 在另一个画质中找到录像。

instruction.en: Try using Reolink Client desktop software instead of mobile app for playback. It provides more reliable playback functionality.
instruction.zh: 尝试使用 Reolink Client 桌面软件而不是手机 App 回放。它提供更可靠的回放功能。

instruction.en: Enable UID: Connect locally > Device Settings > Network > Advanced > UID > toggle ON.
instruction.zh: 启用 UID：本地连接 > 设备设置 > 网络 > 高级 > UID > 打开开关。

instruction.en: Check internet at camera location: Ensure your home network has a working internet connection. The camera needs internet for remote UID access.
instruction.zh: 检查摄像头位置的网络：确保家里网络有正常的互联网连接。摄像头需要互联网才能通过 UID 远程访问。

expected_result.zh: 互联网正常，远程访问恢复。

instruction.en: Change router DNS to 8.8.8.8 (Google) or 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare). Some ISP DNS servers block UID P2P connections.
instruction.zh: 将路由器 DNS 更改为 8.8.8.8（Google）或 1.1.1.1（Cloudflare）。某些 ISP DNS 服务器会阻止 UID P2P 连接。

expected_result.zh: DNS 已更改，远程访问正常。

sop_name.zh: 修复 App 连接问题

instruction.en: Check local network permission: iOS: Settings > Reolink > enable 'Local Network'. Android: ensure app has network access.
instruction.zh: 检查本地网络权限：iOS：设置 > Reolink > 启用「本地网络」。Android：确保 App 有网络访问权限。

instruction.en: Disable VPN/firewall temporarily. Some VPNs block camera discovery on local network.
instruction.zh: 临时关闭 VPN/防火墙。某些 VPN 会阻止本地网络上的摄像头发现。

expected_result.zh: 关闭 VPN 后发现摄像头。

instruction.en: Remove and re-add the camera in the app. Delete the camera entry, then add it again using QR code scan or manual UID entry.
instruction.zh: 在 App 中删除并重新添加摄像头。删除摄像头条目，然后使用二维码扫描或手动输入 UID 重新添加。

expected_result.zh: 摄像头重新添加并可访问。

instruction.en: Switch to Clear stream: In live view, tap the quality toggle to 'Clear' (HD). 'Fluent' mode uses lower resolution.
instruction.zh: 切换到清晰画质：在实时画面中，点击画质切换到「清晰」（高清）。「流畅」模式使用较低分辨率。

instruction.en: Clean the lens with a soft microfiber cloth. Fingerprints and dust cause permanent blur.
instruction.zh: 用柔软的超细纤维布清洁镜头。指纹和灰尘会导致持续模糊。

instruction.en: Check encode settings: Device Settings > Display > Encode. Set resolution to maximum. Increase bitrate for better quality (requires more bandwidth).
instruction.zh: 检查编码设置：设备设置 > 显示 > 编码。将分辨率设置为最大。增加比特率以获得更好画质（需要更多带宽）。

instruction.en: Switch to Fluent stream to reduce bandwidth needs. Tap quality toggle in live view.
instruction.zh: 切换到流畅画质以减少带宽需求。在实时画面中点击画质切换。

instruction.en: Check network speed: WiFi cameras need at least 4Mbps upload for HD streaming. Run a speed test at the camera location. Consider using PoE for stable bandwidth.
instruction.zh: 检查网络速度：WiFi 摄像头需要至少 4Mbps 上传速度才能流畅播放高清画面。在摄像头位置做速度测试。考虑使用 PoE 以获得稳定带宽。

instruction.en: Lower frame rate: Device Settings > Display > Encode > reduce frame rate from 15fps to 10fps. This reduces bandwidth requirements.
instruction.zh: 降低帧率：设备设置 > 显示 > 编码 > 将帧率从 15fps 降低到 10fps。这可以减少带宽需求。

sop_name.zh: 修复 SD 卡未检测到

instruction.en: Reinsert the SD card: Power off camera, remove SD card, wait 10 seconds, reinsert firmly, power on.
instruction.zh: 重新插入 SD 卡：关闭摄像头，取出 SD 卡，等待 10 秒，重新牢固插入，开机。

instruction.en: Format the SD card in the camera: Device Settings > Storage > Format SD Card. The card must be formatted by the camera, not a computer.
instruction.zh: 在摄像头中格式化 SD 卡：设备设置 > 存储 > 格式化 SD 卡。SD 卡必须由摄像头格式化，不能用电脑。

expected_result.zh: SD 卡格式化并正常工作。

instruction.en: Check SD card specs: Must be Class 10 or UHS-1, microSD format, from a reputable brand (SanDisk, Samsung, Kingston). Max capacity depends on camera model (usually 128GB or 256GB). Avoid counterfeit cards.
instruction.zh: 检查 SD 卡规格：必须是 Class 10 或 UHS-1，microSD 格式，来自知名品牌（SanDisk、Samsung、Kingston）。最大容量取决于摄像头型号（通常 128GB 或 256GB）。避免假冒卡。

instruction.en: Enable loop recording: Device Settings > Storage > enable 'Loop Recording' or 'Overwrite'. Oldest footage auto-deletes when full.
instruction.zh: 启用循环录像：设备设置 > 存储 > 启用「循环录像」或「覆盖」。存满时自动删除最旧的录像。

expected_result.zh: 循环录像已启用，录像恢复。

instruction.en: Switch to motion-only recording instead of 24/7 continuous. This uses significantly less storage.
instruction.zh: 切换到仅移动侦测录像而不是 24/7 连续录像。这会显著减少存储使用。

sop_name.zh: 修复 SD 卡不录像

instruction.en: Check recording schedule: Device Settings > Recording Schedule. Ensure recording is enabled for the time periods you need.
instruction.zh: 检查录像计划：设备设置 > 录像计划。确保在您需要的时段启用了录像。

instruction.en: Verify SD card is properly detected and formatted: Device Settings > Storage. Should show card capacity and used/free space.
instruction.zh: 验证 SD 卡已被正确检测和格式化：设备设置 > 存储。应显示卡容量和已用/可用空间。

expected_result.en: SD card shows in storage settings.
expected_result.zh: SD 卡在存储设置中显示。

instruction.en: Enable audio recording: Device Settings > Audio and Light > toggle ON 'Record Audio'.
instruction.zh: 启用录音：设备设置 > 音频和灯光 > 打开「录音」开关。

instruction.en: Check app microphone permission: iOS: Settings > Reolink > Microphone > Allow. Android: Settings > Apps > Reolink > Permissions > Microphone.
instruction.zh: 检查 App 麦克风权限：iOS：设置 > Reolink > 麦克风 > 允许。Android：设置 > 应用 > Reolink > 权限 > 麦克风。

instruction.en: In live view, press and HOLD the talk button to speak. Release to listen. Also check the volume slider at the bottom of the live view.
instruction.zh: 在实时画面中，按住对讲按钮说话。松开后收听。同时检查实时画面底部的音量滑块。

instruction.en: Use earphones/headphones when using two-way audio. This eliminates the feedback loop between your phone speaker and microphone.
instruction.zh: 使用耳机进行双向语音通话。这可以消除手机扬声器和麦克风之间的反馈回路。

instruction.en: Lower the volume on both your phone and the camera speaker settings. High volume increases echo.
instruction.zh: 降低手机和摄像头扬声器设置的音量。音量太高会增加回声。

instruction.en: Increase volume slider in Reolink app live view (bottom of screen). Also increase your phone's media volume.
instruction.zh: 增加 Reolink App 实时画面中的音量滑块（屏幕底部）。同时增加手机的媒体音量。

instruction.en: Check camera speaker placement. If the speaker is obstructed or facing a wall, sound will be muffled. Also ensure nothing is covering the microphone hole.
instruction.zh: 检查摄像头扬声器位置。如果扬声器被遮挡或面向墙壁，声音会被闷住。同时确保没有东西覆盖麦克风孔。

expected_result.zh: 扬声器无遮挡，音量改善。
